title: Ingrown toenail
claims: Do not cut toenails too short when trying to prevent ingrown toenails.
Cut straight across the nail, not the edges.
Do not wear shoes that are too tight or do not fit properly.
Signs of an infected toe include pus coming out of it and feeling hot or shivery.
See a GP if the toe is painful and swollen with pus, or if you have a very high temperature or feel hot, cold or shivery.
People with diabetes and an ingrown toenail should see a GP because foot problems can be more serious with diabetes.
